originality.rationale: The all-height minimum-volume ellipsoid including its sharp phase change was solved by Todd (1982) and is explicitly excluded from the amended originality claim. The surviving claim concerns strict monotonicity of the normalized ellipsoid/cap volume ratio and its sharp thin-cap, positive-height and Gaussian-window dimensional limits. These follow by a nontrivial integral comparison and asymptotic analysis not identified in the inspected Todd primary text. Priority is qualified, and the elementary nature of the deduction is acknowledged.
